instrument: TRACE — Transdiagnostic at-risk mental state screener
population_and_sample: UK general population N=2037 age 14-36 including minors
language_evidence: Original UK research and English-language publication; no independently validated RU/ES or translated editions confirmed
commercial_digital_rights: Article CC BY 4.0 does not independently certify derived third-party instrument content rights or commercial digital administration/scoring; permission review
validation_limitations: Three-factor EGA/CFA within split sample; bifactor model improved fit; reality-distortion specificity questionable; predictive clinical utility untested
safety_gate: research_only; clinician and safeguarding review; no web screening activation

domains: Functional maintenance; Sensory input; Social interaction; Leisure
population_and_sample: Four pilot rounds N70+120+100+180; final EFA N180; adults
language_evidence: English article; language of original administered full final form not independently established; EN/RU/ES translated validations not found
commercial_digital_rights: Article CC BY-NC 4.0; commercial reproduction and SaaS require separate commercial licence; original scale items/score permissions unverified
validation_limitations: Preliminary EFA only; four domains; proposed global score not validated; high alpha not independent confirmation
safety_gate: research_only; no clinical score interpretation, item posting or site release

instrument: Digital Burnout Scale — student AI era
domains: Digital aging (7); Emotional exhaustion (9); Cognitive overload (4); Cognitive dissonance (4); Digital deprivation (8); Behavioral addictions (5)
population_and_sample: University students mainly China with some Malaysia; pilot N50; EFA N130; CFA N279
language_evidence: Original Chinese-region research; precise respondent form language/versions not independently confirmed; EN/RU/ES translations unproven
commercial_digital_rights: Open-access article is not sufficient review of third-party adapted items or authorization for commercial hosted use and auto-scoring
validation_limitations: EFA KMO .66; CFA CFI .90 RMSEA .08; preliminary cross-cultural generalizability; 37 final not 38 initial

instrument: Clergy Well-Being and Work-Related Psychological Health combined measure
domains: Clergy wellbeing: subjective; psychological; spiritual. Work-related health: engagement; stability; fatigue; burnout.
population_and_sample: Taiwan Christian clergy N150 EFA + N437 CFA; largely Protestant, non-generalizable outside clergy
language_evidence: Chinese-speaking Taiwan study of original locally grounded tool; no evidence for separate translated EN/RU/ES versions or cross-region ZH norms
commercial_digital_rights: Composite based in part on prior inventories (Chinese Happiness Inventory; clergy spiritual wellbeing; Francis Burnout; Copenhagen Burnout); obtain underlying item/derivative and commercial online rights
validation_limitations: CWB 3 factors plus WPH 4 factors; gender invariance reported; cross-sectional Taiwan Christian sample only
safety_gate: research_only; no public deployment or claim of clinical diagnostic norms
